description: This file defines the NotesRepository class, which manages note data operations including creation, retrieval, updating, deleting, synchronization status, and reconciliation with remote data sources in a note-taking application.

classes.name: NotesRepository
classes.description: A repository class providing methods to handle note data operations, including CRUD, synchronization, and remote reconciliation.

methods.name: watchNote
methods.description: Streams a specific note by its ID.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note with a unique ID and current timestamp.

methods.name: saveNote
methods.description: Saves or updates a note with the provided title and content.

methods.name: getNotesForPush
methods.description: Retrieves notes that need to be pushed to remote.

methods.name: markNotesSyncing
methods.description: Marks specified notes as currently syncing.

methods.name: markNotesPushedClean
methods.description: Marks specified notes as clean after successful sync.

methods.name: markNotesFailed
methods.description: Marks specified notes as failed to sync.

methods.name: getLastSyncAtMillis
methods.description: Retrieves the timestamp of the last sync.

methods.name: updateLastSyncAtMillis
methods.description: Updates the timestamp of the last sync.

methods.name: reconcileRemoteNotes
methods.description: Reconciles remote notes with local data.

methods.name: purgeSyncedTombstones
methods.description: Removes tombstones of notes that have been synced.
